name: inspect-receptacle
title: Inspect a receptacle
description: Look into a container, a cabinet, an appliance cavity or onto a support and report the objects inside or on it. A closed cabinet is opened for the look and closed again.
use_when: The contents of a container or cabinet must be seen (opens it if needed).

not_to_be_confused_with.search: inspect examines one given receptacle; search chooses where to look.

receptacle.description: Container, articulated cabinet/appliance or support to examine.

contents.description: Objects found inside/on the receptacle and visible.

applicability.summary: Requires base_near(place=$receptacle). Depending on the bound nouns, the chosen path also needs: closed_cabinet (receptacle.kind == 'articulated' and not receptacle.is_open): hand_empty(hand=right).

preconditions.name: base_near
preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

postconditions.name: observed
postconditions.meaning: The robot saw the target in its head camera during this episode (set by look, search, inspect, explore).
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: observed
checks.meaning: The robot saw the target in its head camera during this episode (set by look, search, inspect, explore).
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

extra_preconditions.name: hand_empty
extra_preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

policy_paths.note: Open with the annotation-selected route, look, close again.

next.when: an object found inside must be taken out
every object inside must be removed

fallback_for.when: the object may be inside a closed cabinet

alternative.when: only the receptacle itself must be seen

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
